purpose: One option of a RatingGroup: a star that fills when chosen, or a smiley marked by a selected background.

notFor.case: A single icon the person presses for an action.

Checked=true.visual: Star: icon Content/accent, no fill. Emoji: Surface/selected fill, icon Content/accent.

Default.visual: The fill and icon of its Checked value.

Hover.visual: Action/ghost/hover fill; unchecked icon moves to Content/primary (checked stays Content/accent; a checked emoji keeps Surface/selected).

Disabled.visual: Icon Content/disabled; a checked emoji keeps Surface/selected.

a11y.role: radio (aria-checked); the roving tabindex belongs to the group
a11y.keyboard: Reached through the RatingGroup's single tab stop; arrows and Home / End come from the group.
notes: Fill and icon move on use-hover (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the fill and icon transitions (use-hover) be dropped?
